writeup: Woot has the SKLZ PitchBack baseball and softball pitching net new for $14.99. It is a 2'9" x 4'8" steel-frame rebounder with a strike zone target that returns grounders, line drives and pop flies for solo throwing and fielding practice. Dick's Sporting Goods and SKLZ's own store both charge $44.99 for the same PBK04-000-04 model, so this is about two thirds off.
